candidates.name: Permian Link Project
candidates.sponsor: Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America (Kinder Morgan)
candidates.from: Permian Zone near Pecos County, TX

evidence.note: Non-binding open season for a new 42-inch greenfield pipeline, 2.1 Bcf/d northbound and 0.5 Bcf/d southbound, in service as early as July 2030. Length not stated.
Describes the bidirectional Permian to Midcon project.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not in roster. P0222 is the existing NGPL system and P2555 is the Lockridge extension, neither is this. Length unknown, likely well over 25 km given the Pecos County to Panhandle span.

candidates.name: Permian-to-REX Pipeline
candidates.to: Rockies Express Pipeline and other markets

evidence.note: Binding open season for a new pipeline up to 2.4 Bcf/d, target in service late 2028. Route and length not published.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not in roster. P7863 (REX Critical Energy Reliability Link, 160 mi) is a different project. Length unknown. Start point may be in NM or TX, so slice fit is uncertain.

candidates.name: Monument Pipeline
candidates.to: Houston Ship Channel and LNG shippers area, TX

evidence.note: About 225 miles of pipeline with transportation and storage for utilities, LNG shippers and industrial customers.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Operating Houston-area intrastate gas system with no roster match. Could be partly captured inside P0203 or P0258, but neither names it. Confirm it is transmission, not distribution.

candidates.name: Brazoria Interconnector Gas Pipeline (BIG)
candidates.to: near Iowa Colony, Brazoria County, TX

evidence.note: 42-inch pipeline about 30.5 miles (49 km), about 1.8 Bcf/d, acquired by Spectra from ConocoPhillips.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Possible match to P1297 Stratton Ridge Pipeline (0.5 mi), which looks like a different, shorter piece. Consolidator should decide.

candidates.name: ONEOK WesTex Transmission

evidence.note: Intrastate system of about 2,217 miles up to 24 inches, 777 MMcf/d peak, linking Mid-Continent and Waha.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for ONEOK WesTex. Not P0264 (Enterprise) or P0258 (Tejas).

candidates.name: WTG Gas Transmission
candidates.why_maybe_new: Listed as an active gas transmission operator in the local PHMSA operator file (WTG GAS TRANSMISSION COMPANY, LLC). A web search suggests about 710 mi intrastate in Texas, but no page could be verified (source returned 403). No roster match. Length about 710 mi, unverified.

candidates.name: Kinder Morgan North Texas Pipeline

evidence.note: Announced 85-mile, 30-inch pipeline from Lamar County to Forney, planned in service 2003. Current status not confirmed; the operator is active in PHMSA.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster match. Operating status inferred from the PHMSA operator listing, not verified.
